observations: Both actual local matches visibly show the independently redrawn retro Meryl MGS1 and the custom cyborg Solid Snake, with no round-intro, pause, settings or Dojo overlay obscuring either body.

Meryl preserves red hair, sleeveless top, olive cargo trousers and combat boots associated with the original MGS1 incarnation. This is newly authored retrospective pixel art, not a historical official MSX extraction.
Cyborg Solid Snake remains a human-head adaptation, separate from the fully mechanical Metal Gear costume correction still pending Root integration.
The images prove actual native rendering; they do not certify absolute 1:1 fidelity or original MSX hardware sprite/palette limits.

The headless screenshot makes the Roman-numeral pause icon appear as a blank outline. Normal pause interaction worked; no confirmed product rendering fault is inferred from an unverified font fallback.
scope: Initial functional integration only; mecha and BoxTank art are still changing and excluded from this visual acceptance.
